ns2:course.label: Entrepreneurship for Engineers
ns2:course.description: Fundamental concepts of entrepreneurship and commercialization of new technology in new and existing engineering and high-tech businesses. Guest speaker topics vary, but typically include: evaluation of technologies and business ideas in general; commercializing new technologies; financing through private and public sources; legal issues; product development; marketing; international business issues. Same as TE 460. 1 undergraduate hour. 1 graduate hour. Credit is not given for both ENG 360 and ENG 460.
